_comment: House-ad feed for the free version of ADM. Add objects to "ads" to show banners in the app; leave it empty to show ADM's built-in 'buy a licence to remove ads' promo. Each ad: {"image": "https://.../banner.png", "link": "https://...", "alt": "short description"}. Only https image+link ads are shown; the app picks one at random.
